text: i replay it over and over
the last voicemail is all i have
the volume is way too loud
i walked home in the rain
they took the last one on purpose
the meeting could decide it all
my chest is heavy with worry
the garden is asleep and still
a soft rain keeps steady time
the trail is empty and green
the clock is moving too fast
i checked the lock a third time
the silence on the line scares me
i forgot if i locked the door
the map is in my hand
the boat drifts on still water
the alarm went off all night
i miss the way it was
the phone might ring any second
my mind will not let it rest
no one owns up to it
the call is any minute now
no one noticed i was gone
the ball is in the air
the path is soft with moss
i cannot quiet the drumming in my ears
the app crashed and lost it all
the party ended and i stayed
the evening is mild and gray
we grew up and grew apart
i missed the last chance to say it
they changed the rules on me
the lamp glows amber and low
they broke the shared tool again
i had enough of the delays
what if i said the wrong thing
the meeting ran an hour long
first day at the new job
i am sick of the excuses
they skipped me in the queue
the map led back to nothing
the song reminded me of you
my heart skips when it buzzes
the plan got trashed last minute
i put the second cup away
the second toothbrush is still there
a quiet tea and a book
the desk chair is empty again
i feel so far from everyone
her side of the closet is empty
the bill is more than i thought
i keep checking the rear view
the fee was hidden until now
the porch swing is quiet now
a calm walk along the pier
i keep rehearsing what to say
the parade is turning our way
the market was full of color
the calendar has nothing on it
my thoughts jump from fear to fear
i keep waiting for a call
stop rolling your eyes at me
the form reset and lost it all
they slammed the door in my face
the house is quiet in a bad way
i cannot stop the racing mind
the fire is just embers now
the test is in an hour
the fog would not lift today
the room is dim and warm
a good book by the window
the tea has gone warm and mild
the doctor has not called back
the printer jammed for the fifth time
the shore is quiet at dawn
they broke it and walked away
i keep checking if it sent
my thoughts will not go quiet
i lost the thread of the day
a slow breath in the dark
the horn would not stop honking
i folded the small clothes away
the room is cool dim and still
the porch is cool and still
the last text was months ago
i wave at an empty window
i miss a voice that is gone
my breath is short and quick
the box is at the door
they rescheduled for the third time
what if i am not ready
the deal fell apart on us
i forgot how to feel okay
a low hum from the fan
the email has not been answered
they mocked the idea in the room
the swing hangs still and empty
the fog sits on the field
no one to walk with anymore
i reread the message ten times
the pond mirrors the pale sky
the road was closed with no sign
the sea breathes in and out
i am done with the runaround
we never got to say more
i lost my old friend today
the bed feels too big now
no one saved me a seat
what if i miss the train
i am tired of repeating myself
the numbers do not add up
they left the mess for me
the room holds a soft silence
the house settles for the night
they cut me off in traffic
my hands are cold and damp
a slow ache in the chest
the box of memories stayed shut
the old cafe closed for good
i walked past our old bench
what if the flight is delayed
i keep the door unlocked just in case
we lost touch a long time ago
i feel like something is off
they took credit for my work
the train pulled away without me
the whistle is about to blow
the bell is about to ring
my leg will not stop bouncing
the storm warning just went off
the blanket is heavy and warm
the bill is wrong yet again
my hands will not stop shaking
the room is spinning a little
i am so angry i could shout
what if the plan falls apart
what if the money runs out
i cannot stop the what ifs
i feel a knot in my throat
the report is due at nine
the album ended on a sad note
the site logged me out again
the room still smells like them
the cat sleeps on my lap
a long slow sip of tea
they left the gate wide open
i am fed up with this
the lake was calm and gold
i keep waiting for bad news
the waiting room clock is loud
they cut the budget with no notice
the meadow was full of bees
